pages.title: Experience of life
pages.text: “Every creature has lived its own life and gained its own experience.”$(br2)The Soul Mirror catches echoes of the experience left by your victims. Each kill grants twice as much experience.

pages.title: The final reflection
pages.text: You can hold the mirror or wear it on your belt without changing its power. When the road ahead seems long, the extra experience will help you travel it faster.
